messages:
renee-cs: Heads-up: FinServX reported a flash surge and elevated 429s on their Dedicated pool (df-prod-1) starting ~2026-03-15T10:21Z. They say min_replicas=2, max_replicas=20. Observed sustained 429s + tail latencies spiking to >3s.

alex-support: ack. are there sample request ids / timeline / any client retry behavior? can you paste a short log snippet?

renee-cs: sample from their client test run:
```
RequestID: fin-req-20260315-0001
Model: redwood-v1-quant
Tokens: ~300
Status: 429
x-request-retry-after: 0
client-retries: 3
latency_ms: 3200
```
They also attached a short perf trace showing queues building and many requests served by 2 pods until autoscaler started decisions at 10:22:15.

devon-eng: pulling autoscaler & k8s events for df-prod-1 — saw scale decision at 10:22:18 to add 6 pods but pods stayed in Pending/CrashLoop for a while. k8s events: 
```
Normal Pulling kubelet, pulling image "redwood/runner:v2"
Warning ImagePullBackOff Back-off pulling image "redwood/runner:v2"
Warning Unhealthy Readiness probe failed: HTTP probe failed with statuscode=503
```
Looks like a mix of image pull delays + failing readiness, so the scaler thought it provisioned capacity but the pool never became Ready fast enough.

tara-sre: +1 on devon. additional metric: GPU utilization on shared hosts spiked, OOM throttling on a noisy tenant (other-tenant-3) landed ~10:20 which correlates with longer container startup due to device scheduling latency. warm-cache hit-rate dropped to ~5%. Cold KV cache = extra token work per request, increasing startup time.

alex-support: ok. two paths: immediate customer mitigation + infra fixes. renée can you send repro steps we can run internally and share with customer (so we can reproduce in staging)?

renee-cs: repro steps they used (customer-convenience):
```
# reproduce: burst to 1200 rps across 20s from single region
for i in {1..20}; do 
  hey -c 200 -q 0 -z 20s -m POST -H "Authorization: Bearer <key>" -H "x-customer: finservx" http://api.redwood.internal/v1/generate
done
```
They also set client-side retries to 3.

devon-eng: internal reproduce notes: run similar load against a staging Dedicated pool with min_replicas=2 and same image tag. Observed autoscaler holdoff behavior: controller waits 30s between scale-up waves and startupParallelism=3, so in a burst it adds N in waves which is too slow for this burst profile. Combined with image pull/ready failures we get the observed 429s.

Proposed immediate mitigations (short-term):
- bump min_replicas -> 5 for this customer pool
- enable burst_reserve: 2 (allow temporary overcommit)
- enable image pre-pull via initContainer on node-pool used by df-prod-1
- relax startupProbe/backoff to reduce probe flapping (startupProbe.failureThreshold -> 5, period -> 5s)

Commands to apply (devon):
```
kubectl -n dedicated patch deploy df-prod-1 --patch '{"spec":{"replicas":5}}'
# enable burst reserve in redwood config
redwoodctl pools update df-prod-1 --burst-reserve=2
```

tara-sre: medium-term fixes: tune autoscaler startupParallelism, reduce controller holdoff for rapid bursts, add warm-pool pre-warm policy for customers with flash-sale tags, and add noisy-tenant detection alerting to throttle misbehaving tenants automatically. Also add a post-incident runbook entry for "flash surge warmup starvation".

alex-support: infra-bot — please create a ticket linking logs & k8s events, assign to eng-platform and SRE. tag customer escalation.

infra-bot: Created ticket SF-4897. Attached k8s events, autoscaler decisions, and sample request traces. Assigned to devon-eng, tara-sre.

devon-eng: I will push short-term patch to increase min_replicas + burst_reserve, and enable an image pre-pull flag for df-prod-1. Will monitor readiness counts and LB queue length.

renee-cs: I'll notify FinServX that we're applying temporary capacity changes and request they pause aggressive retries for 10 minutes while we validate.

alex-support: thanks team. follow-up actions:
- devon: patch applied + comment on SF-4897 (ETA 10m)
- tara: add runbook note + postmortem flag (ETA today)
- renee: customer update (done)

renee-cs: customer confirmed retries reduced; saw immediate drop in 429s after we bumped replicas — will keep monitoring. will report back if anything else pops up. :thumbsup:

tara-sre: file an action to quantify how often imagepull/image-backoff interacts with autoscaler waves — we should have a test that simulates cold node start + busy GPUs.

alex-support: closing this Slack thread, continuing tracking in SF-4897. thanks all :rocket:
